hi everyone! ever wanted to.. have custom lms? well, here's a solution for you:
this script gives you ability to replace every single lms [for example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN), or Through Patches of Violet] to custom .mp3 file.
and also it supports lobby theme. cool.

[HOW-TO CUSTOM LMS]
1. download any song that you want to have as lms
example, Eternal Hope, Eternal Fight as A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN)
2. put the .mp3 file to the Workspace folder of your executor
3. rename the .mp3 to original lms theme (in this example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN))
4. in result, you should have "A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN).mp3"
5. run the script

[CREDITS]
1. thanks to Forsaken development team for creating this game
2. thanks to musicians working on Forsaken for making good OST for the game
3. you for using this script

scripts.title: AUTO MATH
scripts.script:
local path = workspace.Billboard.gui.frame.main.main.question
path.RichText = true
local lastQuestion = ""

while true do
    local currentText = path.Text

    if currentText ~= lastQuestion and not currentText:match("<font") then
        local expression = currentText
            :gsub("=", "")
            :gsub("%s+", "")
            :gsub("x", "*")

        local func = loadstring("return " .. expression)
        if func then
            local success, result = pcall(func)
            if success then
                local coloredResult = string.format('<font color="#34c3eb">%s</font>', result)
                path.Text = currentText .. " " .. coloredResult
                lastQuestion = path.Text
            end
        end
    end
    wait(0.2)
end

scripts.title: AUTO MARKER
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local user = player.DisplayName
local mainFrame = workspace.Billboard.gui.frame.main.Frame
local frameText = workspace.Billboard.gui.frame.main.FrameText
local answerBoard = player.PlayerGui.answerUI.MemoryBoard

while true do
	local text = frameText.Text

	if text == "Memorize this pattern!" then
		for _, btn in ipairs(mainFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if btn:IsA("TextButton") and btn.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) then
				btn.TextScaled = true
			end
		end

	elseif text == user .. "'s pattern:" then
		local mainButtons = {}
		local answerButtons = {}

		for _, btn in ipairs(mainFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if btn:IsA("TextButton") then
				table.insert(mainButtons, btn)
			end
		end

		for _, btn in ipairs(answerBoard:GetChildren()) do
			if btn:IsA("TextButton") then
				table.insert(answerButtons, btn)
			end
		end

		for i = 1, math.min(#mainButtons, #answerButtons) do
			if mainButtons[i].TextScaled then
				answerButtons[i].Text = "✅"
				answerButtons[i].TextScaled = true
			end
		end
	end

	wait(0.1)
end
